keyFindings.description: GitHub reports sjawhar/legion#2205 CONFLICTING with main at 4eb701286cf5. The files changed on both sides are packages/contracts/CHANGELOG.md, packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md and scripts/e2e/README.md. A forward merge is needed, with one push carrying it and the fix below.

Lines 98-99 export one TextDecoder for the whole driver. session-settings-omp.ts:114 decodes every Oh My Pi process's stdout with it in stream mode, and several processes run at once. session-settings-services.ts:207 decodes NATS messages with it without stream mode, which flushes the pending state. A multibyte character split at one process's chunk boundary is therefore glued onto another stream. The corrupted line fails JSON.parse, and #take (omp.ts:125-129) drops it without a word, so a lost RPC answer would show up as a timeout in an unrelated check. Fix: create a decoder per Omp reader (inside #read), and decode the NATS message on its own; then drop the export.
